notes: Vouchers are here: enter a coupon code at checkout and the discount is applied to your order
Reserve for Pickup: hold 1–2 pairs for 24 hours, free — no deposit
New-device verification: signing in on a phone we have not seen before asks for a 6-digit code emailed to you, and new sign-ups verify their email address
Store owners: create codes in the new Vouchers screen — percent or fixed amount, minimum order, use limits, end date
Sellers: the Pickup Reservations screen lists incoming holds and records a collected one as a sale in one tap
Track your holds with a countdown in Profile → My Pickup Reservations — cancel any time, or extend once (+24 hours) if you are running late
Best Sellers: a new Best Sellers filter and a home-screen rail show what is selling most, ranked by units sold
Admins: Manage Users → Account Security shows trusted devices, code history and lockouts for any account
White and cream colour swatches now have a visible outline, so they no longer disappear on light cards
The whole app now wears the warm cream look of the seller dashboard
Updates install from inside the app — no more hunting for the APK file yourself
